items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for any rights-dependent or monetization decision. Keep the product private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not commercial/public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, trademark, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms restrict relevant uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, owner, and privacy gates also remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown; incomplete telemetry alone is not a general growth blocker. Revenue remains limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and is not site-attributable. Exact decision: no go-live proposal, no outreach, no monetization expansion, and no public exposure. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering rights, data flow, retention, logs/vendors/incidents, consent/GA4 settings, accuracy/freshness, rollback, and owner disposition, then route unresolved rights and jurisdictional privacy issues to human counsel.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is limited to official Woot API/terms/support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms; none satisfies its complete deliverable. Keep all tasks open. Data-use decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; missing written rights and field-level use limits; smallest action is complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest action is produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review; smallest action is capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or customer matching. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject request procedures; smallest action is produce one read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory. No task may close without direct evidence.

Legal decision for parked scaffold properties: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker; then obtain technical, security, measurement, and legal review before reconsidering launch.

Legal review supports containment-only execution. Do not admit new implementation work or requeue unchanged failures while delivery is saturated, measurement windows remain open, operations/security evidence is unavailable, and attribution is partial. Continue existing measurement and complete or justifiably close saveusfarms.com request 3dd194a6-b7a1-4dce-baee-22af77d5b2e1 with dated ownership, root cause or rationale, isolated validation, rollback, release/security boundary, attribution and measurement limits, and deduplication evidence by 2026-09-30T07:30Z.
